operation.name: CreateNonGBVDetail
operation.query:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT NonGBVMainID FROM [NonGBVMain] WHERE Deleted = 0 AND NonGBVMainID =@NonGBVMainID )) SET @ReturnValue = 0 ELSE BEGIN INSERT INTO [NonGBVDetails] ([NonGBVMainID]
,[ActionResponseComplaint] ,[ActionResolutionDesignation] ,[ActionResolutionDesignationID] ,[FeedbackComplainant] ,[FeedbackComplainantID] ,[DataOfResolution] ,[PendingActionRequered] ,[EscaletedReferredExternally] ,[AppealLodged] ,[AppealDate] ,[AppealOutcomeSatisfactory] ,[UnresolvedReccommended] ,[ClosingDate] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] ,[PendingActionRequeredNote] ,[DetailOfTheAccused] ,[DetailOfTheAccusedOther] ,[HasInvestigation] ,[NameInvestigation] ,[DesignationInvestigation] ,[InvestigationCompletedDate] ,[MainFindingsInvestigation] ,[InvestigationAttachID] ,[InvestigationAction] ,[NameOfTheAccused] ,[StateID] ,[CountyID] ,[PayamID] ,[BomaID] ,[SSSNPAccused] ,[Deleted]) VALUES (@NonGBVMainID
,@ActionResponseComplaint ,@ActionResolutionDesignation ,@ActionResolutionDesignationID ,@FeedbackComplainant ,@FeedbackComplainantID ,@DataOfResolution ,@PendingActionRequered ,@EscaletedReferredExternally ,@AppealLodged ,@AppealDate ,@AppealOutcomeSatisfactory ,@UnresolvedReccommended ,@ClosingDate ,@CreationUserID ,@LastModificationTimestamp ,@LastModificationUserID ,@PendingActionRequeredNote ,@DetailOfTheAccused ,@DetailOfTheAccusedOther ,@HasInvestigation ,@NameInvestigation ,@DesignationInvestigation ,@InvestigationCompletedDate ,@MainFindingsInvestigation ,@InvestigationAttachID ,@InvestigationAction ,@NameOfTheAccused ,@StateID ,@CountyID ,@PayamID ,@BomaID ,@SSSNPAccused ,0)
SET @ReturnValue = SCOPE_IDENTITY() END

operation.name: UpdateNonGBVDetail
operation.query:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT NonGBVMainID FROM [NonGBVDetails] WHERE Deleted = 0 AND NonGBVDetailID = @NonGBVDetailID )) SET @ReturnValue = 0 ELSE BEGIN
UPDATE [NonGBVDetails] SET
[ActionResponseComplaint] = @ActionResponseComplaint ,[ActionResolutionDesignation] = @ActionResolutionDesignation ,[ActionResolutionDesignationID] = @ActionResolutionDesignationID ,[FeedbackComplainant] = @FeedbackComplainant ,[FeedbackComplainantID] = @FeedbackComplainantID ,[DataOfResolution] = @DataOfResolution ,[PendingActionRequered] = @PendingActionRequered ,[EscaletedReferredExternally] = @EscaletedReferredExternally ,[AppealLodged] = @AppealLodged ,[AppealDate] = @AppealDate ,[AppealOutcomeSatisfactory] = @AppealOutcomeSatisfactory ,[UnresolvedReccommended] = @UnresolvedReccommended ,[ClosingDate] = @ClosingDate ,[LastModificationTimestamp] = @LastModificationTimestamp ,[LastModificationUserID] = @LastModificationUserID ,[PendingActionRequeredNote] = @PendingActionRequeredNote ,[DetailOfTheAccused] = @DetailOfTheAccused ,[DetailOfTheAccusedOther] = @DetailOfTheAccusedOther ,[HasInvestigation] = @HasInvestigation ,[NameInvestigation] = @NameInvestigation ,[DesignationInvestigation] = @DesignationInvestigation ,[InvestigationCompletedDate] = @InvestigationCompletedDate ,[MainFindingsInvestigation] = @MainFindingsInvestigation ,[InvestigationAttachID] = @InvestigationAttachID ,[InvestigationAction] = @InvestigationAction ,[NameOfTheAccused] = @NameOfTheAccused ,[StateID] = @StateID ,[CountyID] = @CountyID ,[PayamID] = @PayamID ,[BomaID] = @BomaID ,[SSSNPAccused] = @SSSNPAccused WHERE Deleted = 0 and NonGBVDetailID = @NonGBVDetailID
SET @ReturnValue = 1
END

operation.name: GetNonGBVDetails
operation.query:
SELECT [NonGBVDetailID] ,D.[NonGBVMainID]
,D.[ActionResponseComplaint] ,D.[ActionResolutionDesignation] ,d.[ActionResolutionDesignationID] ,D.[FeedbackComplainant] ,D.[FeedbackComplainantID] ,D.[DataOfResolution] ,D.[PendingActionRequered] ,D.[EscaletedReferredExternally] ,D.[AppealLodged] ,D.[AppealDate] ,D.[AppealOutcomeSatisfactory] ,D.[UnresolvedReccommended] ,D.[ClosingDate] ,D.[CreationUserID] ,D.[LastModificationTimestamp] ,D.[LastModificationUserID] ,D.[PendingActionRequeredNote] ,D.[DetailOfTheAccused] ,d.[DetailOfTheAccusedOther] ,D.HasInvestigation ,D.NameInvestigation ,D.DesignationInvestigation ,D.InvestigationCompletedDate ,D.MainFindingsInvestigation ,D.InvestigationAttachID ,d.InvestigationAction ,d.[NameOfTheAccused] ,d.[StateID] ,d.[CountyID] ,d.[PayamID] ,d.[BomaID] ,d.[SSSNPAccused] ,m.[Status] FROM [NonGBVDetails] as D inner join NonGBVMain as M on M.NonGBVMainID = d.NonGBVMainID WHERE D.DELETED = 0 AND D.NonGBVMainID = @NonGBVMainID ORDER BY NonGBVDetailID ASC

operation.name: GetNonGBVDetail
operation.query:
SELECT [NonGBVDetailID] ,[NonGBVMainID]
,[ActionResponseComplaint] ,[ActionResolutionDesignation] ,[ActionResolutionDesignationID] ,[FeedbackComplainant] ,[FeedbackComplainantID] ,[DataOfResolution] ,[PendingActionRequered] ,[EscaletedReferredExternally] ,[AppealLodged] ,[AppealDate] ,[AppealOutcomeSatisfactory] ,[UnresolvedReccommended] ,[ClosingDate] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] ,[PendingActionRequeredNote] ,[DetailOfTheAccused] ,[DetailOfTheAccusedOther] ,HasInvestigation ,NameInvestigation ,DesignationInvestigation ,InvestigationCompletedDate ,MainFindingsInvestigation ,InvestigationAttachID ,InvestigationAction ,[NameOfTheAccused] ,[StateID] ,[CountyID] ,[PayamID] ,[BomaID] ,[SSSNPAccused] FROM [NonGBVDetails] WHERE DELETED = 0 AND NonGBVDetailID = @NonGBVDetailID

operation.name: DeleteNonGBVDetail
operation.query:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT NonGBVMainID FROM [NonGBVDetails] WHERE Deleted = 0 AND NonGBVDetailID = @NonGBVDetailID )) SET @ReturnValue = 0 ELSE BEGIN
UPDATE [NonGBVDetails] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @UserID ,[Deleted] = 1 WHERE NonGBVDetailID = @NonGBVDetailID
SET @ReturnValue = 1
END
